## Discovery & Translational Science

* **Harvard team maintains brain organoids for over five years** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/19/brain-organoids-alive-5-years-neuroscience-research-harvard/)
  * Human brain organoids kept in long-term culture (>5 years) continued to mature and develop, displaying molecular and genetic signatures characteristic of adult human brain tissue.

* ***Plasmodium falciparum* px1 locus linked to emerging antimalarial resistance in Uganda** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04624-y)
  * Genomic surveillance identified a rapidly spreading haplotype on chromosome 7 of *Plasmodium falciparum* containing mutations and deletions in the *px1* gene.
  * The locus strongly correlates with reduced parasite susceptibility to first-line antimalarials lumefantrine and dihydroartemisinin.

* **Monoclonal antibody targeting ADAMTS-7 attenuates experimental atherosclerosis** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.11.744317)
  * Researchers developed mAb32, a high-affinity monoclonal antibody expressed in *Nicotiana benthamiana* that inhibits interactions between ADAMTS-7 and its substrates TIMP-1 and SVEP1.
  * In *ApoE*⁻/⁻ mice fed a Western diet, six weeks of weekly mAb32 administration significantly reduced aortic plaque area without altering plasma cholesterol levels or body weight.

* **Airway-blood multiomics identifies circulating respiratory epithelial cells in preterms** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.17.26360603)
  * Integrated single-cell RNA sequencing and proteomics of matched pharyngeal aspirates and whole blood across 19 neonates defined immune adaptation across the airway-blood axis in early postnatal life.
  * The study revealed a circulating respiratory epithelial-like cell population in neonatal blood whose abundance correlated directly with degree of prematurity and severe lung disease.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **IncobotulinumtoxinA shows comparable headache relief in TBI and anomalous health incidents** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.18.26360627)
  * A single-center observational study evaluated incobotulinumtoxinA in patients with persistent migraine-like headaches secondary to traumatic brain injury (TBI; n=19) or Anomalous Health Incidents (AHI; n=11).
  * Mean Headache Impact Test-6 (HIT-6) scores improved by 12 points in the TBI group and 9.5 points in the AHI group from baseline to peak effect, demonstrating statistically indistinguishable clinical benefit.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** / **[Biotech]** **Merck and Moderna's mRNA cancer vaccine hits primary endpoints in pivotal melanoma trial** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/moderna-merck-cancer-vaccine-landmark-result-melanoma/828238/)
  * A Phase 3 trial evaluating Moderna’s individualized mRNA vaccine (mRNA-4157/V940) combined with Merck’s Keytruda (pembrolizumab) in over 1,000 patients with high-risk resected stage IIB–IV cutaneous melanoma met its primary endpoints.
  * Independent monitoring recommended declaring success at a pre-planned interim analysis after the combination demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in recurrence-free survival and prevention of distant metastasis over Keytruda alone.
  * Detailed clinical data will be presented at an upcoming medical conference; the regimen is also undergoing Phase 3 development in lung, kidney, and bladder cancers. (See also coverage in [Science](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/merck-and-moderna-s-melanoma-results)).

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA approves Regeneron's Pasatru for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-second-treatment-fibrodysplasia-ossificans-progressiva)
  * The FDA approved Pasatru (garetosmab-grts), a monoclonal antibody that targets activin A to block abnormal activin A receptor-type 1 (ACVR1) signalling, to reduce new heterotopic ossification and disease flare-ups in adults with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP).
  * Approval was based on a double-blind, placebo-controlled study in 63 adults evaluating a 10 mg/kg IV infusion every four weeks (with a dose reduction option to 3 mg/kg).
  * Pasatru represents the second FDA-approved therapy for this ultra-rare, debilitating genetic condition (see additional coverage in [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/19/regeneron-fop-garetosmab-fda-approval-pasatru/)).

* **[Biotech]** **FDA grants accelerated approval to Genglycos, the first therapy for GSDIa** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-therapy-patients-aged-8-years-and-older-glycogen-storage-disease-type-ia)
  * The agency approved Genglycos (pariglasgene brecaparvovec-opnr) to reduce daily cornstarch intake as an adjunct to dietary management in patients aged 8 years and older with glycogen storage disease type Ia (GSDIa).
  * Caused by a deficiency in glucose-6-phosphatase, GSDIa prevents glycogen breakdown into glucose; Genglycos is the first approved disease-modifying gene therapy for the condition.

* **Trump nominates White House policy aide Heidi Overton as FDA Commissioner** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/overton-fda-commissioner-trump-white-house-appointment-plans/828264/)
  * President Donald Trump nominated Heidi Overton, MD, White House deputy director of domestic policy and former chief policy officer at the America First Policy Institute, to serve as FDA commissioner.
  * If confirmed by the Senate, Overton will take over leadership following the resignation of Marty Makary in May and interim stewardship by Kyle Diamantas (see additional reporting in [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/19/heidi-overton-fda-commissioner-nominee-competing-interests-ahead/)).

* **FDA authorizes Aletta, the first standalone robotic blood draw device** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-authorizes-first-its-kind-robotic-blood-draw-device)
  * The agency authorized Aletta, an autonomous robotic device designed to draw blood from adult patients in outpatient settings without hands-on operator intervention during venipuncture.
  * Intended to help address phlebotomist shortages, the protocol allows a single phlebotomist to oversee up to three Aletta units concurrently.

* **[Big Pharma]** **B. Braun issues recall for Lactated Ringers Injection due to particulate contamination** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/b-braun-medical-inc-issues-voluntary-north-american-recall-excelr-lactated-ringers-injection-1000ml)
  * B. Braun Medical voluntarily recalled one lot of Excel Lactated Ringers Injection (1,000 mL) after discovering particulate matter primarily identified as cellulose cotton and wood fibers and polystyrene.

## Business & Strategy

* **GLP-1 development shifts toward whole-product profiles over incremental weight loss** [X / @andrewpannu](https://x.com/andrewpannu/status/2090081364980748306)
  * With efficacy benchmarks exceeding ~20% weight loss for injectables, the competitive landscape in metabolic disease is fragmenting around specific patient sub-populations rather than pure peak efficacy.
  * R&D strategies are increasingly targeting differentiated profiles, including oral convenience, lean-mass preservation, optimized weight loss kinetics, improved tolerability, and hard clinical outcomes across CV, CKD, MASH, and neuropsychiatric comorbidities.

- Biology & Health
    - [MDMA and psilocybin for PTSD and depression | Linus Abrams, M.D.](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/g72jo0LdEO0) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Episode #404 of The Drive examines estradiol's role as a critical brain hormone in both men and women that regulates multiple neurotransmitter systems.
        - It highlights the clinical importance of distinguishing bipolar disorder from ordinary depression, including how the menopause transition can bring lifelong cases to light.
        - It addresses chronically elevated cortisol as a pervasive, hard-to-treat factor in modern mental health struggles, alongside evolutionary mismatches driving rising anxiety and depression.
    - [What If AI Could Double Healthcare Capacity?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nOILH3h8ilA) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Simon Kos discusses expanding healthcare AI applications beyond standard AI scribes.
        - The primary objective is reducing both administrative overhead and cognitive burden across clinical workflows.
        - The discussion centers on how AI technology could potentially double overall healthcare capacity.
    - [Beyond the AI Scribe: Heidi’s Vision for the Future of Healthcare with Thomas Kelly & Simon Kos](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UGsh-wpGWRw) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Heidi leadership outlines the evolution from an AI medical scribe to a broader clinical AI platform designed to double global healthcare capacity.
        - The episode addresses operational and clinical challenges including AI hallucinations, time savings, medical billing, upcoding, and EHR integration.
        - Heidi builds specialized medical AI models to maintain technical differentiation and compete against tech hyperscalers like Microsoft and Epic.
        - The conversation explores expansion into US health systems, hardware strategies, product-led growth, and potential FDA regulation for AI scribes.
- Pure Science
    - [The Wavy Window Paradox](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4YvnVJRlQQs) -- minutephysics
        - The video examines the optical physics principles that allow clear image transmission through transparent window glass.
        - It applies Snell's Law to explain the behavior and refraction of light passing through parallel glass surfaces.
        - It analyzes why everyday visual perception remains undisturbed despite light passing through solid glass mediums.
